svg.title: 320毫秒请求：并行区间与等待汇合
svg.desc: 一条共同教学时间轴。入口0到320毫秒，应用10到310毫秒。库存调用30到130毫秒，物流调用40到270毫秒，两者都完成后才能组装响应。两子跨度重叠90毫秒，并集240毫秒，时长相加330毫秒。物流结束较晚，决定270毫秒的汇合点。该图不是实际HTTP实验的时序。
svg.metadata: {"kind":"parallel-request-timeline","unit":"ms","clock":"One shared teaching timeline, not cross-host timestamps or actual HTTP timing","spans":[{"id":"entry","parent":null,"start_ms":0,"end_ms":320},{"id":"app","parent":"entry","start_ms":10,"end_ms":310},{"id":"inventory","parent":"app","start_ms":30,"end_ms":130},{"id":"logistics","parent":"app","start_ms":40,"end_ms":270}],"join":{"at_ms":270,"waits_for":["inventory","logistics"]},"child_union_ms":240,"child_sum_ms":330,"overlap_ms":90,"end_to_end_ms":320,"critical_branch":"logistics","logistics_breakdown_ms":{"thread_wait":170,"execution":40,"transport":20},"counterfactual_ms":{"shorten_logistics_by":20,"join_after_logistics_change":250,"shorten_inventory_by":20,"join_after_inventory_change":270},"scope":"Given blocking dependency and fixed other intervals; no CPU measurement or HTTP run"}
svg.text: 并行调用：区间相加 ≠ 用户等待
一条320ms订单请求 · 同一教学时钟 · 两个子调用都返回后才组装结果
子时长和100+230=330ms；减去重叠90ms，才得到覆盖区间240ms。
物流决定汇合：它缩短20ms，汇合可到250ms；只缩库存20ms，仍在270ms。
物流230ms可继续拆为等待170 + 执行40 + 传输20；跨度长不等于CPU忙。
父子表示操作归属；汇合箭头表示必须等待两者结束。独立于实际两段HTTP实验。
